    <title>Scheduled firewall maintenance</title>
    <content type="html"><p><strong>THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Aug <var data-var='date'>30</var>, <var data-var='time'>08:00</var> - <var data-var='time'>11:00</var> UTC</strong></p> <p> <small>Aug <var data-var='date'>25</var>, <var data-var='time'>17:23</var> UTC</small><br> <strong>Scheduled</strong> - We’ll be performing scheduled firewall maintenance at one of our data centers on August 30, 2026, from 1:00 AM to 4:00 AM PDT. This work may temporarily affect traffic to some Cerebras Inference Cloud endpoints.<br />We expect any customer-visible interruption to total less than five minutes. However, intermittent unavailability could occur at any point during the three-hour maintenance window. Affected requests may fail or experience increased latency.<br />We recommend retrying failed requests with exponential backoff and avoiding time-sensitive batch workloads during the maintenance window.<br />If the work extends beyond the scheduled window, we’ll provide an updated completion estimate. </p></content>
